search_notes: Alphabetical, unranked snapshot verified on 2026-10-02. Every included repository passed gh api repos/OWNER/REPO and repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest checks: public, archived=false, and a release or verified default-branch commit within the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-04. README install paths or release assets establish Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 routes; WSL2 suitability is inferred from Linux support. The agentsview seed redirects to the canonical kenn-io repository. Excluded seeds: Phoenix's [README](https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix#copyright-patent-and-license) specifies ELv2 licensing; claude-code-otel has no latest release and its [default-branch commit](https://github.com/ColeMurray/claude-code-otel/commit/43263654a369) dates to 2025-06-17; ccusage's [README](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/main/apps/ccusage/README.md) establishes billing reports, while full session/tool-call inspection was not established. coding_agent_session_search was excluded because its [license](https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/coding_agent_session_search/blob/main/LICENSE) restricts specified parties. Used 30 GitHub API calls, 3 web-search attempts and 6 page-fetch attempts; web search failed, so discovery used GitHub repository search. No working-directory files were opened. Coverage is bounded by the requested research budget.
